docs.title: 🧬 Scientific Term Extraction Pipeline
docs.text: Production-ready pipeline for extracting biomedical terminology optimized for Common Data Model (CDM) implementation

docs.title: 🎯 Overview
docs.text: This advanced pipeline extracts high-quality biomedical terminology from scientific literature using 4 sciSpaCy models, multi-layer filtering, and semantic deduplication to achieve 98.4% accuracy in extracting clinically relevant terms.

docs.title: ✨ Key Features
docs.text:
• 🔬 Multi-Model NER: 4 specialized sciSpaCy models running in parallel
  • 🔍 4-Layer Filtering: Basic → Advanced → Biomedical → CDM optimization
  • 🔄 3-Strategy Deduplication: Exact → Fuzzy → Semantic (with upgraded Nomic v1.5)
  • 🏥 CDM Integration: Optimized for Common Data Model terminology
  • 💾 Multi-Format Output: JSON, CSV, SQLite with CDM schema
  • 🚀 Production Ready: FastAPI, Docker, monitoring stack

docs.title: 📊 Performance Metrics
docs.text: Pipeline Version Output Terms Quality CDM Ready CDM-Optimized 1,585 98.4% 60%

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/your-repo/spacy_terms.git
cd spacy_terms

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Install sciSpaCy models
pip install https://github.com/allenai/scispacy/releases/download/v0.5.1/en_core_sci_lg-0.5.1.tar.gz
pip install https://github.com/allenai/scispacy/releases/download/v0.5.1/en_ner_craft_md-0.5.1.tar.gz
pip install https://github.com/allenai/scispacy/releases/download/v0.5.1/en_ner_bc5cdr_md-0.5.1.tar.gz
pip install https://github.com/allenai/scispacy/releases/download/v0.5.1/en_ner_jnlpba_md-0.5.1.tar.gz

docs.title: Basic Usage
docs.text:
# Extract terms with CDM optimization
python main.py --input_dir ./data --output_formats json csv sqlite

# Use upgraded Nomic v1.5 model
python main.py --input_dir ./data --semantic_model nomic

docs.title: 🏥 CDM Integration
docs.text:
The pipeline produces 60% CDM-ready terms across key domains:

  • 🏥 Condition/Disease: 34% (bacterial infection, antibiotic resistance)
  • 🔬 Procedure/Observation: 28% (DNA extraction, sequencing)
  • 💊 Drug/Substance: 15% (antibiotic treatment, medications)
  • 📊 Measurement: 18% (microbiota diversity, abundance)
  • 👤 Person/Subject: 5% (age-related, demographics)

docs.title: 🔧 Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python: 3.8+ (3.9+ recommended)
  • Memory: 4GB+ RAM for semantic models
  • Storage: 2GB+ for spaCy models
  • OS: Linux, macOS, Windows (WSL2)

docs.title: 1. Clone Repository
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/your-repo/spacy_terms.git
cd spacy_terms

docs.title: 2. Create Virtual Environment
docs.text:
# Using conda (recommended)
conda create -n sci-term-extraction python=3.9
conda activate sci-term-extraction

# Or using venv
python -m venv sci-term-extraction
source sci-term-extraction/bin/activate  # Linux/macOS
# sci-term-extraction\Scripts\activate  # Windows

docs.title: 3. Install Dependencies
docs.text:
# Core dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Install sciSpaCy models
pip install https://github.com/allenai/scispacy/releases/download/v0.5.1/en_core_sci_lg-0.5.1.tar.gz
pip install https://github.com/allenai/scispacy/releases/download/v0.5.1/en_ner_craft_md-0.5.1.tar.gz
pip install https://github.com/allenai/scispacy/releases/download/v0.5.1/en_ner_bc5cdr_md-0.5.1.tar.gz
pip install https://github.com/allenai/scispacy/releases/download/v0.5.1/en_ner_jnlpba_md-0.5.1.tar.gz

docs.title: Using Docker Hub (Recommended)
docs.text:
# Pull pre-built image
docker pull your-registry/sci-term-extractor:latest

# Run container
docker run -p 8000:8000 -v $(pwd)/data:/app/data your-registry/sci-term-extractor

docs.title: Build from Source
docs.text:
# Build image
docker build -t sci-term-extractor .

# Run container
docker run -p 8000:8000 -v $(pwd)/data:/app/data sci-term-extractor

docs.title: Docker Compose
docs.text:
# Full stack with monitoring
docker-compose up -d

# API only
docker-compose up -d term-extractor

docs.title: Model Loading Errors
docs.text:

pip uninstall en_core_sci_lg en_ner_craft_md en_ner_bc5cdr_md en_ner_jnlpba_md
pip install https://github.com/allenai/scispacy/releases/download/v0.5.1/en_core_sci_lg-0.5.1.tar.gz
# ... repeat for other models

docs.title: Import Errors
docs.text:
# Ensure Python path includes src
export PYTHONPATH="${PYTHONPATH}:$(pwd)"

docs.title: Docker Issues
docs.text:
# Clean up Docker cache
docker system prune -a
docker build --no-cache -t sci-term-extractor .

docs.title: Performance Tips
docs.text:
1. Use SSD: Faster model loading and file processing
  2. Increase Memory: Add RAM for better semantic model performance
  3. GPU Acceleration: Use CUDA for semantic embedding computations
  4. Batch Processing: Process multiple files simultaneously
